criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 6 and 9 dark, staged and well lit; frame 7 counts 13 against 10; frame 4's widths measure to one scale. Four lean on defaults: 5 an overhead grille on a mid-tone field with a muddy brown open stretch; 3 a mannequin beside a broadside pack reading as a fence in a void; 8 a mannequin at a flat table in an empty bay; 4 a bar chart in copper. Frame 2's lit block of 33 doesn't read.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight world, casts right, the ember accent meaning one thing, a camera move through one site, a declared value cut, a dark deck that doesn't strobe; 3 and 4 in a void, 8 its own room.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral on every surface traced to a quote, claim or compute.py. The repaired cooling claim re-derived by hand: first by rate (0.41) and fourth by count, and page 4's percent rows agree. The first comment describes only drawn things. Looser phrasings: 'answered' for 'responded', 'often undecided' for 'many projects', and 'every load zone' beside four drawn zones, flagged in the dek.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, when, where and the next date are named; the stake stays general; c36 and c38 verified and unused.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 6 is a real turn carried by 7; 8 a cuttable detour; 2 and 3 cover close ground.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on house rules, close to bureaucratic with N/A on five frames; the caption's closing question the best line.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 60, 19 days ago, used the same RFI and a copper bus bar relief; empty bolted pads, caliche and lastLight recur; a follow-up rather than a re-skin.

one_sentence_fix: Replace frame 8's Batch Zero detour with a frame that gives cooling its Texas stake and a date, c36 and c38, without saying the report is on that agenda.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An orthographic grille on a mid-tone field reads as an HVAC register; the ember stretch muddy brown.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A low raking key, caliche grain falling to black outside a pool, the open stretch at true dusk_ember with visible depth.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin beside a broadside pack reading as a wooden fence in a void.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-quarter view on the end face, the pack and worker seated in the caliche pool with contact shadows, the worker cropped at the knee.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin at a flat table in an empty bay; the stack a beige block; the lamp's pool on the floor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and closer so the lit stack and table edge own the lower half, the figure cropped at the shoulders, the pool on the paper.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Four packs dead-on at one depth on black read as a bar chart.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A lower camera and a harder rake from the left, the dunnage and caliche pool running toward the camera, one depth kept.
